title: Export finishes, then crashes on exit, with Admob and gdUnit4 installed
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6.3.stable, 4.7.2.stable and 4.8-dev6.

This is related to #122899 but not the same thing.  

With gdUnit4 installed and nothing else, 4.7.2 crashes on export and 4.8-dev6 exits cleanly. If you then install the Admob addon then 4.8-dev6 crashes again.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6 - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors (1920x1200 @ 60.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - REMBRANDT (rembrandt, LLVM 15.0.7, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-138-generic) - AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 6850U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 27.17 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I encountered this problem while debugging another developers game which was failing during CI build.

Godot does the whole export, writes the pack, but then then dies as it is terminating with exit code 134. The exported files are fine and the game builds from them, so it's only the exit that fails, but that is enough to fail a CI build.

It only exists when both addons are installed.  It is a very specific issue which feels like an edge case - but these two addons are very popular so I expect to see the crash again. 

On 4.8-dev6 the error I see is:

```
corrupted size vs. prev_size in fastbins
Aborted (core dumped)
```

On 4.7.2 i see a segfault instead, which is very similar to #122899

### Steps to reproduce

The crash happens on the standard "Dodge the Creeps" demo, with the gdUnit4 and Admob addons.

1. Dodge the Creeps, from godot-demo-projects
2. Add gdUnit4 6.1.3
3. Add Admob 7.0 from godot-sdk-integrations/godot-admob
4. Export for Android

I did use an AI agent to help me identify what combination of things caused it, it said:

> Three things have to be true:
> 
> 1. an object with a script on it, stored in `Engine` metadata
> 2. a signal on that object, connected to a callable
> 3. the object that owns that callable never freed
> 
> Take any one away and it exits cleanly.

I tested the agents assertion that all things need to be present. The agent was also able to reduce it down to a single script which triggers the crash:

```gdscript
extends SceneTree

class Sig extends RefCounted:
	signal terminate()

class N extends Node:
	func _init() -> void:
		var s: Sig = Engine.get_meta("S")
		s.terminate.connect(func() -> void: print(get_children()))

func _initialize() -> void:
	Engine.set_meta("S", Sig.new())
	var _n := N.new()      # never freed
	quit()
```
